mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF ( ID, LINK_ID, METRIC_NAME, METRIC_UNIT, COLLECT_DESC, TIME_WINDOW, SORT_ORDER, CREATE_TIME )
SELECT #{item.id}, #{item.linkId}, #{item.metricName}, #{item.metricUnit}, #{item.collectDesc}, #{item.timeWindow}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.createTime} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF WHERE LINK_ID = #{linkId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, METRIC_NAME
